McpServerDefinition.description: Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional data): read-only Program Exceptions Desk tools. List today's program exceptions from CRM data and check for a duplicate open case before creating one.

tools.descriptionOverride: Read-only. Lists Zenthera Patient Support Program (demo, fictional) exceptions from CRM data: overdue or due-soon refills (recorded shipments only), delayed or long-shipped shipments, no shipment after enrollment, consent pending, open safety reviews, duplicate open cases, uncategorised cases and missing data (DATA_INCOMPLETE). Use for "show today's program exceptions", "which shipments are delayed" or "what needs attention for ENR-0007". All inputs optional: asOfDate (YYYY-MM-DD), enrollmentNumber, exceptionTypes (comma separated, e.g. SHIPMENT_DELAYED), pageSize, afterEnrollmentNumber (next page). Show resultMessage and itemsText as written. Suggested actions need the user's approval; never create cases yourself. Never say whether a patient took the medication; no medical advice.

Read-only. Before creating a Zenthera Patient Support Program service case, checks for an open case with the same patient, issue category and shipment. Inputs: enrollmentNumber (ENR-...) or patientId; category (Shipment Delay, Refill Support, Insurance Support, General Program Support or Possible Adverse Event); optional dispenseNumber (DSP-...). Returns resultCode: EXISTING_CASE (do not create; see matchingCaseNumbers), POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE (open case of that category without a shipment link: ask the user), NO_DUPLICATE (a case may be created only after the user approves), INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND or ERROR; plus resultMessage (show it) and unclassifiedOpenCaseNumbers (open cases without a category). Never creates a case.
